title: HermesProfile record
description: The per-agent instance record (profile.yaml) pushed to the GitOps repo. v1alpha2 removes four fields no consumer read: spec.targetCluster, spec.reach (whose only key was regions), and spec.deployment.{machineType,region,diskType} - leftovers from the deleted VM compute path. See plugin/schemas/README.md for the migration note. Fully-resolved instance record for a single installed Hermes agent — PLAIN HELM VALUES for the hermes-profile chart, not a Kubernetes custom resource (there is no HermesProfile CRD). The record's identity is its directory name (profiles/<name>/profile.yaml, read by the ApplicationSet as {{.path.basename}}); the emitter enforces the name rules (DNS-1123 label, max 40 chars). Desired-state only; no status block.

source.description: Git URL or path, e.g. github.com/factorylevel/support-agent

gitAuthSecretRef.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret in the instance's own namespace holding the credential to clone a PRIVATE spec.source: keys username+password (HTTPS PAT) or ssh-privatekey (SSH deploy key). Omit for public sources.

sourceSubdir.description: Subdirectory of spec.source containing the distribution (the Hermes fork's --subdir / #subdirectory= install form). The pod boot path installs /tmp/dist/<sourceSubdir> from its clone. Omit for root-layout sources.

sha.description: Full commit SHA (40 lowercase hex chars).

apps.description: The RESOLVED helm apps this instance launches, in author order - the emitter has already deep-merged author values + fleet defaults + per-instance appValues overrides into `values`, and every `valuesRequired` dot-path was satisfied pre-render (so that field is dropped from the record). The chart renders one Argo CD Application per entry (app-of-apps).

name.description: DNS-label app name, unique within the record.

chart.description: Chart name in the remote helm repo, or (for `repo: local`) the chart's path inside the platform/GitOps chart tree.

repo.description: Helm repo URL (https:// or oci://), or the reserved word `local` (chart ships with the platform/GitOps repo).

version.description: Chart version - present for remote repos (the Application's targetRevision), absent for `repo: local`.

values.description: The fully-merged chart values (author values + fleet defaults + per-instance overrides), inlined.
